description: This file defines TypeScript types, interfaces, and functions for converting JSON schemas and OpenAI tools into Gemini schema and function declarations, including content parts and safety ratings.

methods.name: convertJsonSchemaToGeminiSchema
methods.description: Converts a JSON schema object into a GeminiObjectSchema.

methods.name: convertOpenAIToolToGeminiFunction
methods.description: Converts an OpenAI ChatCompletionTool object into a GeminiToolFunctionDeclaration.
